reason: VALUE: 0 on score by construction (calibration only, read on 30 Sep), so it cannot help private. Its stated benefit, freezing the read before the numbers are seen, already exists. The v2 pre-registration (CONTEXT l.2570-2598) is in bf07763, and `git branch -r --contains bf07763` = origin/main. HEAD d1ccc85 == origin/main, so the L1-L7 and DC-dose addenda are pushed too. What the script would add is arithmetic on 3-dp differences, and there is almost no post-hoc freedom in that. The real remaining freedoms are unresolved definitions. (1) In (e), S is in thousandths but D is a 'lab sum'; the units and the lab value for the 'borrowed' P38->P37 and the in-sample P34->P35 are not fixed (round12/v_hyp_post_deadline_r12p-3.json). (2) 'C1-C5 and I': I is undefined (CONTEXT l.2591). (3) Identifying the X copy run: the LB CSV has only Rank/TeamId/LastSubmissionDate/3-dp Score, with no per-submission time, so the (c) tie read is not mechanical. A script author would settle these silently in code. That is new pre-registration hidden in a .py rather than in dated text. The proposed gate (pytest synthetic worlds hitting rows i-vii) is circular: it checks the author's encoding against the same author's reading and cannot validate the interpretation. The motivating lessons (edge filter +0.016 lab -> 0 LB, dc0.30 sign flip) were lab->LB transfer failures, not reshaping of the read, so a script would not have prevented them. FEASIBILITY: the script is harmless if offline (CSV inputs only, no ListSubmissions calls, which would compete with the port session's 429 budget under E10 rule (5)). R8 does not apply (no submit). But it spends 1-2 agent-hours on 28 Sep, when E10 v3, exp71/exp72 and the finals re-tick are live. The actual missing guard, I-336 (LESSONS s3 item 11 + P1 pushed), is still uncommitted (IDEAS.md l.542). A commit and push from a research round could also sweep in other sessions' dirty files (ledger.md, poll.log, e10_snapshot.py are modified now).
fix: Do not build tools/private_read.py before the deadline. Instead, before 29 Sep 23:00Z: (a) commit and push I-336 as text (LESSONS s3 item 11 + P1: at least one of L1/L2/L4 non-zero on private, prior 0.55-0.70), as the user with no trailer, staging only those files. (b) Add one dated CONTEXT line that settles the open definitions. S and D both in thousandths. D per E pair = the ledger lab deltas (P27->P28 +1.9, P34->P35 +6.3 in-sample upper bound, P38->P37 'borrowed = P27->P28', P28->P31 its ledger value). Drop 'I' or define it. X = the private score of our exact-x138 ref; X rank = count of LB rows with private > X, plus the 3-dp bin width. The (c) tie read uses only the Rank column. If a script is still wanted, write it after 29 Sep 20:00Z from that frozen text (optionally commit it before 23:00Z). It reads CSVs only, never calls the API, and the text wins on any conflict.
realistic_gain: 0 on public/private score. Calibration only: it would remove maybe 2-3 small interpretive freedoms, and the dated text line in the fix removes them at ~10 min cost versus 1-2 agent-hours for the script.
